note: Checks expected to fail until the named 4.3 plan item lands. verify-release.mjs reports such a suite as XFAIL, and as XPASS (a failure) once every listed check passes, so each entry is removed by the change that fixes it. label is a regular expression over check labels; browser and modes (candidate, release, staged-release, prebuilt) narrow an entry.

entries.label: ^candidate: .* ((composed block words|link names|heading names) equal source|leaves offscreen blocks waiting)$
entries.reason: test:release runs the committed packages/typeset-v4/dist, which is the published 4.2.0 build with the joined-word defect until 4.3.0 is cut, and with no stale mode to leave offscreen blocks waiting after a narrowing resize.

entries.label: : (a break that replaces a space is exposed to assistive technology|spacing and hanging markers are hidden and display:inline)$|^legacy renderFrozenLines (runs under Trusted Types with no policy|sets no role and keeps the words|keeps the heading name)$|: a line that starts at a link breaks before the link: never first inside it, no empty stub on the line before$|: TypesetRichText: a line that starts at a link right after another element or a fragment breaks before the link, with no stub$
entries.reason: test:release runs the committed 4.2.0 dist, which hides generated breaks, uses inline-block markers and sets role=text in renderFrozenLines (C2), and puts a break that starts a line at a link first inside the link.

entries.label: ^(strict CSP|without the policy):
entries.reason: test:release runs the committed 4.2.0 dist, which restores styles through the style attribute (C5).

entries.label: : nothing hidden reaches the clipboard that native copy leaves out$|: no engine markers, data-ts or adapter attributes, or wrap override in the HTML$|^select all: the author's inline styles survive, including a text-wrap-style the engine overrode$|^(select all|within p4, across the source's line wraps|all of p4): plain text equals native copy of the uncomposed page$
entries.reason: test:release runs the committed 4.2.0 dist, whose copy handler serializes hidden content (C11), copies its text-wrap-style override and data-ts-stale with each host, pastes a paragraph's source white space (hard wraps, indentation, tabs) and keeps no-break spaces.

entries.label: under (mount\(\)|the website loader): |^typeset\(\) and restore\(\) without a controller
entries.reason: test:release runs the committed 4.2.0 dist and website loader, which leave stale framework text and crash React (C6).
test:release runs the committed 4.2.0 dist, which composes live regions (C4).

entries.label: ^education: |^server HTML: TypesetText with (smartQuotes and no lang|lang="en") has curled quotes$|: TypesetRichText without lang warns once$|: TypesetRichText with a component child stays native and warns once$
entries.reason: test:release runs the committed 4.2.0 dist, with the quote misfires and client-only TypesetText education (C15), and no development warnings for TypesetRichText.

entries.label: ^typeset\(\) on a paragraph with an 11,000-character "[.)]" run costs about what plain text of its length does$
entries.reason: test:release runs the committed 4.2.0 dist, whose unanchored trailing-punctuation patterns take 0.2 s (closing parentheses) to 12 s (periods) on such a paragraph in WebKit.

test:release runs the committed packages/typeset-v4/dist, the published 4.2.0 adapters, which recompose on every parent render and resize frame, keep a controller per block, drop refs and have no onResult (P4, P5, K5).
The committed 4.2.0 declarations reject as="div", refs, onResult and priority, and inline @types/react 19.2 internals that fail with @types/react 18.

entries.label: ^sri\.json: typeset\.(min|esm)\.js is a ledger-listed immutable path$
entries.reason: The committed public/sri.json was written by the 4.2.0 cut, which also hashed the mutable aliases typeset.min.js and typeset.esm.js. The 4.3.0 cut rewrites it with sriIndex(), which lists only immutable, ledger-listed paths (K6).

entries.label: ^package go\.js without \[data-typeset\] targets logs one console\.info
entries.reason: test:release runs the committed 4.2.0 dist, whose go.js stays silent when no element matches (K6).

entries.label: ^(React adapters declare their public React types|exports \./auto -> dist/auto\.js|unpacked package is under 1\.9 MB|dist/\S+ keeps all four third-party license notices|only typeset\.global\.js and go\.js ship source maps)
entries.reason: test:release packs the committed 4.2.0 dist beside the 4.3 package.json: it has inferred React types, no dist/auto.js, maps with embedded sources and no license comments (K3, K6, K7).
